apoio.missao: RELIABILITAS exists to give maintenance and reliability professionals — from technician to engineer — free access, in PT and EN, to the rigorous knowledge usually locked behind paid standards and expensive training.
apoio.promessa: For individuals it is free forever: no paywall, no sign-up, no cookies. Donations are what keep the infrastructure running.
apoio.canaisEmBreve: Donation channels (Pix, PayPal and Ko-fi) will be published here soon.
apoio.destinoTexto: Hosting, database and domain infrastructure (~R$ 130/month). Any surplus funds collection growth: new assets, failure modes and translations. No ads, no data selling — ever.

home.sub: Industrial reliability knowledge — open to everyone.
home.heroLinha: What the failure is, how to detect it, which strategy to use and the math behind it — per asset, with cited sources, for free.
home.metodoIntro: Every failure mode goes through two frameworks, in this order:
home.metodoATexto: How the failure behaves over time: category and Weibull β (Nowlan & Heap).
home.metodoBTexto: The applicable and effective task: TBM, CBM, Proof Test or RTF (SAE JA1011 / Moubray).
home.niveisLinha: Every failure mode in 3 reading levels — Understand, Apply, Master — in PT and EN.
home.apoieTexto: Free forever for individuals. Donations keep the infrastructure running.

calc.intro: Three everyday tools for the reliability engineer — 100% in your browser: no data leaves this page.

weibull.invalido: Invalid inputs: β and η must be positive.
weibull.rodape: R(t) = exp(−(t/η)^β) · h(t) = (β/η)·(t/η)^(β−1). Validated against Smith (2004) and known properties (R(η)=e⁻¹). The note's editorial category prevails over this didactic reading.

disp.rodape: Ai = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR) — inherent availability (Smith 2004, ch. 2). Reference year: 8760 h.

pf.rodape: An on-condition task is only effective if inspection fits the P-F window — consecrated practice: inspection ≤ P-F/2 (Moubray, RCM II ch. 8).

busca.dica: Try broader terms — e.g. cavitation, NPSH, bearing.
